text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Christmas. With the Arima Kinen right 
before her, Twin Turbo...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone—! We're gonna play our 
hearts out today—!! Happy blastoff—!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, does happiness usually explode?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's the same as always, huh. Even 
though she looked so cool during the All 
Comers.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose that's just what makes 
Turbo, Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Still, wasn't that wonderful? Tokai Teio 
making it in time for the Arima Kinen, I 
mean.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe this is thanks to Turbo too. Right, 
Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's the best news ever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After continuing her rehab since then, 
Tokai Teio miraculously had her comeback 
set for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With this, Twin Turbo's wish came true. 
And just as wonderful was another miracle—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayyy☆ Alright everyone, wanna hit up a 
pre-party 'here we go'!? 1, 2, 3, say!!

text_block_list.name: The Six
text_block_list.text:
Congrats to all six of you for qualifying 
for the Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was truly an incredible feat. For all 
six of us here to be selected for the 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the driving force behind that was—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tbh, wasn't Turbo the one who hyped our 
season up right from the get-go?☆

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You're right. After putting on a race like 
that in the All Comers to kick off the 
autumn season.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Right, right? You'd better all thank me! 
It's all thanks to Turbo, after all!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... You always get carried away so 
easily. If only you didn't have that 
habit."

text_block_list.name: The Six
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Laughter rings out. And just like that, 
the fun Christmas party begins...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, now then. Time for a riddle. The 
"Arima Kinen" is written with the 
characters for "having horses," but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Why do we exist in the first place? The 
answer is different for each and every one 
of us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Everyone thought for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! To get everyone hyped☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's part of it, but... Isn't it to 
hype things up and entertain the fans?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fans? I wouldn't say anything that grand. 
Like... I was just born, so I guess I'm 
here?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I believe reasons to exist are something 
each person creates for themselves.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you guys got it wrong. That's not 
how it is."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Alright then, full-of-confidence 
Turbo-san!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The reason for Turbo and the others' 
existence is...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: To run with joy!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What about you, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah. At least my Trainer gets it. As 
long as I can have fun running, that's all 
that matters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see. Because the two of you are in 
complete sync, you can race without any 
hesitation at all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. These two are truly like horse and 
rider acting as one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What the two of us aimed for. That was the 
one thing that never wavered from the very 
start. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Burning completely out while having fun. 
That was the very reason Twin Turbo was 
born."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Still, though... it's precisely because 
Turbo is so pure that..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
For the upcoming Arima Kinen, I don't just 
want her to run—I want her to blow 
everyone away.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Gotta show 'em who's boss?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. Along with having fun, I want them 
to leave behind huge footprints too, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, like, let's leave our mark as the 
'casuals are the strongest' crew?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. Exactly because it's packed with 
such powerhouse contenders you can't beat 
on sheer hype alone...”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I want them to fully demonstrate just how 
amazing it is to run for fun and to 
entertain others."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Of course Turbo's up for it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show Teio and everyone else just 
how amazing Turbo is!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Will I be able to... show them all? Yes, 
this year's Arima Kinen is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looked like it was going to be an 
incredible dream race.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I am—not invincible. Nor am I undefeated. 
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm here to show everyone a miracle. I'll 
definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The resurrected prodigy, Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian, I run to prove that I am the 
strongest. And—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna surpass you! Let's 
settle this one-on-one!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I don't intend to prove anything to 
anyone. It's just—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Whoever runs ahead of me gets slashed 
down. —That is all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The rogue lone wolf, Narita Brian. —The 
1-on-1 dorm leader, Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket, the Umamusume competing in the 
Arima Kinen are all formidable, regardless 
of generation. However—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Let us prove that BNW is the strongest. 
Through our system of simultaneous 
equations."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Hayahide! We're gonna do this for 
Taishin tooooo!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The formula for victory, Biwa Hayahide. 
—Pure, all-out passion, Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Miss Bourbon... Rice will run. Even 
without you there, Miss Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice will show them she's right here. 
So...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The Blue Rose Assassin, Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why they exist differs from person to 
person. Butâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume runs with their very 
existence on the line. And at the 
forefront of this glorious race, Twin 
Turbo takes the lead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume runs with their very 
existence on the line. And at the 
forefront of this glorious race, Twin 
Turbo takes the lead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with the party over, I decided to head 
out with Twin Turbo, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Turbo wants to do way, way more 
Christmassy stuff!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something Christmas-y... What comes to 
mind is...
choice_data_list: Do you want a toy or something?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The least I can do is buy her a Christmas 
present, but..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo doesn't need childish stuff like 
that~. More importantly...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I wanna play and play and play my heart 
out! I don't need any presents or things 
that last until tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Party like crazy... Setting aside whether 
that's childish or not...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than material things, Twin Turbo 
just wants to enjoy today to the fullest. 
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's do a Horror Night speedrun! 
A speedrun!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"We'll just run away and leave the zombies 
behind! And blow past the werewolf before 
he transforms!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A night pool! Trainer, let's have a splash 
fight! A splash fight!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, Turbo's got a secret weapon. So I'm 
not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what a stylish tower…… Which means 
what we gotta do is……

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm gonna run a lap at full 
speed! Let's see how many seconds it takes 
me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Twin Turbo played around like a 
whirlwind. And then...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Guggghhhh... Gahhhhh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, she's completely exhausted, 
sleeping on my back. Having enjoyed 
Christmas to the fullest, and――"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Gonna do it... the Arima Kinen... 
Turbo... EXPLOOOOSION...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even in my dreams, she's running wild. 
This Umamusume, who's like a 
jack-in-the-box where you never know 
what'll pop out...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's deliver it to Nakayama Racecourse at 
the close of the year. That will be the 
greatest Christmas present of all to the 
Umamusume fans.
